lastCompletedStory.title: Assert closeIssueOnMain bumps updatedAt on close

nextStoryContext: Added a single unit test 'close: updatedAt is bumped to clock() value beyond original createdAt' just before the '4. mergeIssueOnMain' section header (after the demote block), mirroring the abandon/demote updatedAt-bump tests. Imported closeIssueOnMain and CloseIssueOnMainOptions into the test file's import block (previously only specify/abandon/demote/merge were imported). No makeCloseOpts helper was added since only one close test exists; options are built inline and typed as CloseIssueOnMainOptions to keep the type import used (avoids an unused-import lint/knip flag). src/commands/issue-specify.ts was not touched.
